value.rationale: The exact finite-aspect constant of a canonical anisotropic cell interpolation is a natural sharp invariant for quasi-Banach free spaces. It strengthens the previously known uniform rectangle bound without merely reproducing its limit and gives a complete r-parameter classification, an interior optimizer and nontrivial strict dependence on cell eccentricity. Nontrivial all-parameter concavity and 16-tree certificates show it is not a routine substitution or an isolated unmotivated number.
